$comment: Single source of truth for GitHub Actions secrets and variables (NAMES and metadata only — never values). Reusable across repos. Update this file in the same PR that adds a secret/variable, plus .env.example and the workflow.

secrets.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
secrets.scope: single purpose: administrative assistant only; never used by booking logic
secrets.notes: Optional. Without it the assistant is disabled and booking still works. Runtime value lives in Apps Script Script Properties; this GitHub copy is only for the gated live smoke test.

secrets.name: GROQ_API_KEY
secrets.scope: fallback LLM provider slot in Llm.gs LLM_CHAIN
secrets.notes: Declared so the name is reserved; do NOT add a PROVIDERS entry until the live smoke test exists for it.

secrets.name: CELIA_ADMIN_PIN
secrets.scope: staff PIN; environment-scoped so no PR job can read it
secrets.notes: Must satisfy the same rules as Script Properties ADMIN_PIN (>=16 chars, not 2468, not a single repeated character).

variables.name: LLM_PRIMARY
variables.notes: Must exist in Llm.gs LLM.PROVIDERS. Apps Script reads LLM_CHAIN from Script Properties; keep them aligned.

variables.name: LLM_SMOKE_ENABLED
variables.notes: Explicit opt-in: turns a missing secret into a hard failure instead of a skip (useful when rotating).

forbidden_in_workflows: inline ${{ secrets.X }} inside run: text (must go through env:)

rotation.runbook: 1 revoke at provider → 2 create new key → 3 update GitHub secret + Script Properties → 4 purge from history if committed → 5 record the date in 'rotated'
